== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ドッキング・ベイ94</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、１フォース必要。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、２フォース必要。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Tatooine: Docking Bay 94]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. To move from here to another docking bay, 1 Force is required. Dark Side. To move from here to another docking bay, 2 Force is required.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese omits English “Your” and says 移動 rather than docking bay transit. Light costs 1 Force. Dark costs 2 Force. One Light Force icon and one Dark Force icon.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinedockingbay94.gif|Original English face]], [[Tatooine: Docking Bay 94]].</ref>
